text:
RENTAL AGREEMENT

This agreement of rent is made and executed at HYDERABAD on this 3rd day of January 2027 BETWEEN Sri. K. Ramesh Babu, aged 58 yrs, R/o Plot No. 12, Road No. 3, Banjara Hills (hereinafter called the LANDLORD) AND Smt. P. Swathi, aged 31 yrs (hereinafter called the TENANT).

1. That the monthly rent of the schedule premises is fixed at Rs.18,500/- (Rupees Eighteen Thousand Five Hundred only) per month, payable on or before 5th of every English calendar month.
2. That the tenant has paid a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only) as interest free security deposit, which will be refunded at the time of vacating the premises.
3. That the tenancy is for a period of 11 (Eleven) months from 01-02-2027 and may be extended on mutual consent with an increase of 5% on the then rent.
4. That either party can terminate the tenancy by giving 2 (two) months notice in writing to the other.
5. That the tenant shall pay electricity charges as per meter and Rs.500 per month towards water charges.

3.1 Rent: Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only per month.
3.2 Deposit: The Tenant shall deposit an amount equal to two months' rent (i.e. Rs.50,000/-) with the Landlord.
3.3 The above deposit of Rs. 50,000 shall not be adjusted against rent.
4.1 The Tenant shall not vacate before the expiry of 8 months from the commencement date (Lock-in), failing which a penalty of one month rent shall be payable.
4.2 After the lock-in, the Tenant shall give thirty days notice to terminate and the Landlord shall give 60 days notice.
5. Rent shall be enhanced @ 7.5 % after every 11 months.
